public_rationale: The research supports the empirical and conditional character of scaling laws. Kaplan and colleagues describe measured loss relationships; data-constrained experiments show that repeated data can exhaust the value of additional compute. Support applies to this methodological reading. It does not establish that scaling had already ended, or that the relationships lacked theoretical explanations.
limitations: The result depends on reading the sentence in light of the surrounding hedges about scaling having stopped.
Loss scaling does not establish equivalent improvements in reasoning or factual reliability.
Theoretical explanations existed before the post.
